description_en: Completes the file upload action after a file upload task is created
description_zh: 创建文件上传任务后，调用本接口完成上传动作
kebab_example: aliyun ecd complete-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-shanghai+cds-4658780000 --upload-id 6C48B55A1FAC4E1A9E05790595140000 --file-id 635a316c94f40f35f5354da29b2aee88c9d10000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompleteCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The username. You must specify at least one of `EndUserId` and `GroupId`
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。`EndUserId`和`GroupId`必须至少传入一个
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file upload task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247619.html to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件上传任务的ID。可调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247619.html获取
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.help_en: The team workspace ID. You must specify at least one of `EndUserId` and `GroupId`
parameters.help_zh: 团队空间ID。`EndUserId`和`GroupId`必须至少传入一个
parameters.name: group_id
